title: quercus oleoides var. lutescens
intro: Quercus oleoides var. lutescens, commonly known as the golden oak, is a variety of the Quercus oleoides plant, a species of oak tree native to tropical Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The golden oak has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant health benefits, which can help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of Quercus oleoides var. lutescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
